# jenkins_plugin (Data Source)

Get information about an installed Jenkins plugin by its short name.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The short name of the plugin to look up (e.g. `workflow-multibranch`).

### Read-Only

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the plugin is currently active.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the plugin is enabled.
- `id` (String) The short name of the plugin, used as the resource identifier.
- `long_name` (String) The human-readable display name of the plugin.
- `url` (String) The URL of the plugin's homepage.
- `version` (String) The installed version of the plugin (e.g. `756.v891d88f2cd46`).
